groups.en: Speaking · the semester ending, and a year of seasons
Listening · a radio show turns one, and a letter home
Task · how to enjoy living in Korea

level.name: 한국에 온 지 벌써 6개월이 되었어요
level.nameEn: 2B Unit 18 · Six months in Korea already
level.description: Farm the Unit 18 word list — how long it has been since you did something, a year of Korean weather, and the plain style you write it all down in.
level.descriptionEn: Learn to say how long something has been going on, describe each season’s weather, and write in the plain style — with the last chapter’s listening, reading and workbook exercises.

words.example: 고향에 가면 친구들이 많이 그리울 것 같아요.
words.exampleEn: I think I will miss my friends a lot when I go home.

words.en: to be a pity; to feel sorry to lose
words.example: 가족을 만날 수 있어서 좋기는 하지만 한국을 떠나는 건 아쉬워요.
words.exampleEn: I am glad I get to see my family, but it is a shame to leave Korea.

words.example: 그 말을 한 것이 정말 후회가 돼요.
words.exampleEn: I really regret having said that.

words.en: to stay in one’s memory most of all
words.example: 그중에서 친구와 여행 간 일이 가장 기억에 남아요.
words.exampleEn: Of all of it, the trip I took with a friend is what stays with me most.

words.en: to have a reason; to have something come up
words.example: 다음 주에 우리 반 친구들이 같이 여행을 가는데 저는 사정이 있어서 못 가게 됐어요.
words.exampleEn: My class is going on a trip next week, but something has come up and I cannot go.

words.example: 고향에 가는 것은 좋지만 친구들과 헤어지는 것이 정말 아쉽습니다.
words.exampleEn: Going home is good, but parting from my friends is a real shame.

words.en: to make friends; to go out with
words.example: 두 사람이 사귄 지 얼마나 됐어요?
words.exampleEn: How long have the two of them been going out?

words.example: 처음보다 한국 생활에 많이 익숙해졌다.
words.exampleEn: I have got much more used to life in Korea than at the start.

words.example: 맞아요. 시간이 정말 빨리 지나간 것 같아요.
words.exampleEn: You are right. Time really does seem to have gone quickly.

words.example: 하지만 한국은 사계절이 있다.
words.exampleEn: Korea, though, has four distinct seasons.

words.example: 내가 제일 좋아하는 계절은 가을이다.
words.exampleEn: My favourite season is autumn.

words.example: 바람이 불어서 시원하다.
words.exampleEn: There is a breeze, so it is cool.

words.example: 오랫동안 비가 안 와서 요즘 너무 건조해요.
words.exampleEn: It has not rained for ages, so it is terribly dry at the moment.

words.example: 보통 언제 장마가 시작돼요?
words.exampleEn: When does the rainy season usually start?

words.example: 또 장마가 있어서 비가 많이 온다.
words.exampleEn: There is also a rainy season, so it rains a great deal.

words.example: 여름에는 날씨가 매우 덥고 습도가 높다.
words.exampleEn: In summer the weather is very hot and the humidity is high.

words.example: 요즘 산에 단풍이 들어서 참 아름다워요.
words.exampleEn: The hills have turned colour lately and they are really lovely.

words.example: 사람들은 단풍을 구경하러 산에 간다.
words.exampleEn: People go up into the mountains to look at the autumn colours.

words.example: 여러분과 나뭇잎이 떨어지는 가을, 눈 내리는 겨울, 꽃 피는 봄, 그리고 뜨거운 여름을 보냈는데요.
words.exampleEn: With you we have been through the autumn of falling leaves, the snowy winter, the spring of blossom and the hot summer.

words.example: 낮에는 따뜻한데 아침저녁에는 날씨가 쌀쌀해서 긴 옷을 입어야 돼요.
words.exampleEn: It is warm in the daytime, but chilly morning and evening, so you need long sleeves.

words.example: 낮에는 따뜻한데 아침저녁에는 날씨가 쌀쌀해서 긴 옷을 입어야 돼요.
words.exampleEn: It is warm in the daytime, but chilly morning and evening, so you need long sleeves.

words.example: 길에 얼음이 얼어서 미끄러우니까 조심해서 가세요.
words.exampleEn: The road has iced over and is slippery, so mind how you go.

words.example: 길에 얼음이 얼어서 미끄러우니까 조심해서 가세요.
words.exampleEn: The road has iced over and is slippery, so mind how you go.

words.example: 지금도 눈이 내려요? 아니요, 지금은 안 와요.
words.exampleEn: Is it still snowing? No, it has stopped now.

words.example: 1월에는 기온이 영하로 내려가는 날이 많아서 아주 추워요.
words.exampleEn: In January there are a lot of days below zero, so it is very cold.

words.example: 비가 많이 오고 습도가 높아서 빨래가 잘 안 말라요.
words.exampleEn: It rains a lot and the air is humid, so the washing does not dry well.

words.example: 이번 주말에 같이 등산 갈래요?
words.exampleEn: Shall we go hiking together this weekend?

words.example: 나는 스키를 타 본 적이 없어서 이번 겨울에 친구들과 스키장에 가 보려고 한다.
words.exampleEn: I have never skied, so this winter I mean to go to a ski resort with my friends.

words.example: 우리 나라는 계절의 변화가 거의 없고 일 년 내내 따뜻한 편이다.
words.exampleEn: My country has almost no change of season and is warm all year round.

words.en: how long it has been since you did it
words.example: 한국에 온 지 벌써 네 달 됐어요.
words.exampleEn: It has already been four months since I came to Korea.

words.en: as many as — surprise at the amount
words.example: 아니에요. 두 그릇이나 먹었어요.
words.exampleEn: No thank you. I have had two whole bowls.

words.en: the plain style, for writing and diaries
words.example: 시간이 빨리 지나간다.
words.exampleEn: Time goes by quickly.

words.example: 내일부터 방학이다.
words.exampleEn: The holidays start tomorrow.

words.example: 민영 씨는 개가 다섯 마리나 있어요.
words.exampleEn: Minyeong has five whole dogs.

words.example: 배가 고파서 밥을 두 그릇 먹었어요.
words.exampleEn: I was hungry so I ate two bowls of rice.

words.example: 저는 안 마실래요. 벌써 세 잔이나 마셨어요.
words.exampleEn: None for me. I have had three cups already.

words.example: 봄에는 여러 가지 꽃이 핀다.
words.exampleEn: All sorts of flowers bloom in spring.

words.example: 여기는 주차장이 아니다.
words.exampleEn: This is not a car park.

words.example: 오늘은 월요일이다.
words.exampleEn: Today is Monday.

words.example: 내일부터 설 연휴다.
words.exampleEn: The New Year holidays start tomorrow.

words.en: the New Year bow to one’s elders
words.example: 설날 아침에는 어른들께 세배를 한다.
words.exampleEn: On New Year’s morning you bow to your elders.

words.example: 한국 사람들은 설날에 별일이 없으면 모두 고향에 내려간다.
words.exampleEn: Unless something comes up, Koreans all go down to their home towns for New Year.

words.en: to be blocked; to be jammed

words.example: 신발이 참 편해 보인다.
words.exampleEn: Those shoes look really comfortable.

words.example: 남대문시장은 서울에서 제일 큰 시장이다.
words.exampleEn: Namdaemun Market is the biggest market in Seoul.

words.example: 남대문시장에 가면 싸고 좋은 물건을 살 수 있다.
words.exampleEn: At Namdaemun Market you can buy good things cheaply.

words.example: 감기에 걸리지 않으려면 먼저 손을 깨끗하게 씻어야 한다.
words.exampleEn: To avoid catching a cold you first have to wash your hands properly.

words.example: 이 약을 먹은 지 한 시간쯤 됐어요.
words.exampleEn: It has been about an hour since I took this medicine.

words.example: 술을 안 마신 지 오래됐어요.
words.exampleEn: It has been a long time since I last drank.

words.example: 대학교를 졸업한 지 일 년 되었어요.
words.exampleEn: It has been a year since I graduated from university.

words.example: 늦게 일어나서 아홉 시 기차를 놓쳤다.
words.exampleEn: I got up late and missed the nine o’clock train.

words.en: to see someone home; to take someone there

words.example: 나는 지난가을에 제주도에 갔다.
words.exampleEn: I went to Jeju last autumn.

words.en: to be a long time since
words.example: 술을 안 마신 지 오래됐어요.
words.exampleEn: It has been a long time since I last drank.

words.categoryEn: Speaking · the semester ending, and a year of seasons
words.example: 우리 나라는 계절의 변화가 거의 없고 일 년 내내 따뜻한 편이다.
words.exampleEn: My country has almost no change of season and is warm all year round.

words.categoryEn: Speaking · the semester ending, and a year of seasons
words.example: 그래요? 왜 갑자기 돌아가게 됐어요?
words.exampleEn: Really? What made you go back all of a sudden?

words.categoryEn: Speaking · the semester ending, and a year of seasons
words.example: 나나 씨, 다음 학기에도 계속 공부하지요?
words.exampleEn: Nana, you are carrying on studying next semester too, aren’t you?

words.categoryEn: Speaking · the semester ending, and a year of seasons
words.example: 아니요, 다음 학기에 고향으로 돌아가요.
words.exampleEn: No — I am going back home next semester.

words.categoryEn: Speaking · the semester ending, and a year of seasons
words.example: 나는 머리가 짧다.
words.exampleEn: I have short hair.

words.categoryEn: Speaking · the semester ending, and a year of seasons

words.en: to put it in a single word
words.categoryEn: Speaking · the semester ending, and a year of seasons
words.example: 여러분의 한국 생활을 한 단어로 말하면 뭐라고 할 수 있습니까?
words.exampleEn: If you had to put your life in Korea in a single word, what would it be?

words.en: to go on air; to start broadcasting
words.categoryEn: Listening · a radio show turns one, and a letter home
words.example: 오늘은 저희 방송을 시작한 지 일 년이 되는 날입니다.
words.exampleEn: Today marks a year since we first went on air.

words.categoryEn: Listening · a radio show turns one, and a letter home
words.example: 이 프로그램은 매일 오후 4시에 방송을 한다.
words.exampleEn: This programme goes out every day at four in the afternoon.

words.categoryEn: Listening · a radio show turns one, and a letter home
words.example: 앞으로도 매일 오후 4시, 잊지 말고 찾아 주세요.
words.exampleEn: Do not forget us — every day at four in the afternoon, from now on too.

words.categoryEn: Listening · a radio show turns one, and a letter home
words.example: 오늘도 처음 시작한 날처럼 바람도 시원하고 창밖으로 보이는 단풍도 참 아름답네요.
words.exampleEn: Today, like that first day, the breeze is cool and the autumn colours out of the window are lovely.

words.categoryEn: Listening · a radio show turns one, and a letter home
words.example: 창밖으로 보이는 단풍도 참 아름답네요.
words.exampleEn: The autumn colours out of the window really are lovely.

words.categoryEn: Listening · a radio show turns one, and a letter home
words.example: 여러분과 나뭇잎이 떨어지는 가을, 눈 내리는 겨울, 꽃 피는 봄, 그리고 뜨거운 여름을 보냈는데요.
words.exampleEn: With you we have been through the autumn of falling leaves, the snowy winter, the spring of blossom and the hot summer.

words.en: a piece of writing; a letter in
words.categoryEn: Listening · a radio show turns one, and a letter home
words.example: 그동안 여러분이 보내 주신 글을 보며 울고 웃으면서 행복한 일 년을 보냈습니다.
words.exampleEn: All this time your letters have made us cry and laugh through a happy year.

words.categoryEn: Listening · a radio show turns one, and a letter home

words.en: to be together with; to join in
words.categoryEn: Listening · a radio show turns one, and a letter home
words.example: 함께해 주셔서 정말 감사합니다.
words.exampleEn: Thank you so much for being with us.

words.categoryEn: Listening · a radio show turns one, and a letter home
words.example: 앞으로도 매일 오후 4시, 잊지 말고 찾아 주세요.
words.exampleEn: Do not forget us — every day at four in the afternoon, from now on too.

words.en: a listener’s story; the tale behind it
words.categoryEn: Listening · a radio show turns one, and a letter home
words.example: 다음은 한국에서 공부하고 계시는 주디 씨의 사연인데요.
words.exampleEn: Next is the story of Judy, who is studying here in Korea.

words.categoryEn: Listening · a radio show turns one, and a letter home
words.example: 멀리 독일에서 오셨군요.
words.exampleEn: You have come all the way from Germany.

words.categoryEn: Listening · a radio show turns one, and a letter home
words.example: 멀리 독일에서 오셨군요.
words.exampleEn: You have come all the way from Germany.

words.categoryEn: Listening · a radio show turns one, and a letter home
words.example: 이제 고향으로 돌아갈 날이 일주일밖에 남지 않았습니다.
words.exampleEn: There is only a week left now before I go home.

words.categoryEn: Listening · a radio show turns one, and a letter home

words.example: 여름 방학에 3주 동안 한국어를 배우러 왔는데 그때 홈스테이를 했다.
words.exampleEn: I came for three weeks in the summer holidays to learn Korean, and I did a homestay then.

words.example: 홈스테이 가족들은 나를 진짜 가족처럼 대해 주셨다.
words.exampleEn: The homestay family treated me like real family.

words.example: 홈스테이 가족들은 나를 진짜 가족처럼 대해 주셨다.
words.exampleEn: The homestay family treated me like real family.

words.example: 한국에 처음 왔을 때보다 한국어 실력이 많이 늘었다.
words.exampleEn: My Korean has come on a lot since I first arrived.

words.example: 한국에 처음 왔을 때보다 한국어 실력이 많이 늘었다.
words.exampleEn: My Korean has come on a lot since I first arrived.

words.example: 가족처럼 대해 주셔서 정말 감사했습니다.
words.exampleEn: Thank you so much for treating me like family.

words.categoryEn: Task · how to enjoy living in Korea
words.example: 한국에서 즐겁게 생활하는 방법을 이야기해 봅시다.
words.exampleEn: Let’s talk about ways to enjoy living in Korea.

words.categoryEn: Task · how to enjoy living in Korea
words.example: 한국에서 즐겁게 생활하는 방법을 이야기해 봅시다.
words.exampleEn: Let’s talk about ways to enjoy living in Korea.

words.categoryEn: Task · how to enjoy living in Korea

words.example: 여러분은 한국 시를 읽어 본 적이 있습니까?
words.exampleEn: Have you ever read a Korean poem?

words.example: 위 시와 같이 계절에 어울리는 시를 써 보세요.
words.exampleEn: Write a poem that suits a season, like the one above.

words.example: 밑줄 친 곳의 발음에 주의해서 읽어 보세요.
words.exampleEn: Read it aloud, minding the pronunciation of the underlined parts.

words.en: to pay attention; to take care
words.example: 밑줄 친 곳의 발음에 주의해서 읽어 보세요.
words.exampleEn: Read it aloud, minding the pronunciation of the underlined parts.
